item.title: Keto Broccoli with Cheese Sauce and Bacon
item.description: This Roasted Broccoli with Cheese Sauce and Bacon is the perfect side dish to accompany just about any keto main dish recipe. Fresh broccoli florets, drizzled with olive oil and seasoned with salt and pepper, and then roasted to perfection and topped with a silky cheddar cheese sauce and crispy bacon. Best of all, it is low carb, keto-friendly, and gluten free. The post Keto Broccoli with Cheese Sauce and Bacon appeared first on Peace Love and Low Carb.

item.title: Creamy Keto Tuscan Chicken (Marry Me Chicken)
item.description: This delicious Creamy Keto Tuscan Chicken Recipe (also know as Marry Me Chicken) is made with perfectly seasoned and pan-seared chicken breasts, simmered in a velvety sauce made with sun-dried tomatoes, spinach, garlic, red onions, heavy cream and parmesan cheese. Best of all, this dish only dirties one pan and can be made in just 30 minutes. (keto, low carb, gluten free) The post Creamy Keto Tuscan Chicken (Marry Me Chicken) appeared first on Peace Love and Low Carb.

item.title: Keto Crack Chicken (Cheesy Bacon Ranch Chicken)
item.description: This Cheesy Bacon Ranch Chicken Recipe (a.k.a Keto Crack Chicken Recipe) is made with juicy, perfectly seasoned chicken breasts, stuffed with a rich mixture of cream cheese, sharp cheddar cheese, ranch dressing, bacon and green onions. It is loaded with flavor, but easy to make. It only calls for 7 main ingredients and can be ready in just over 30 minutes. The post Keto Crack Chicken (Cheesy Bacon Ranch Chicken) appeared first on Peace Love and Low Carb.

item.title: Keto Beef Stew (low carb, gluten free)
item.description: Warm up with a comforting and satisfying bowl of Keto Beef Stew. Made with juicy, tender beef, crispy bacon, mushrooms, carrots, peppers, tomatoes, onion, and garlic, simmered in a rich, flavorful broth. This easy slow cooker beef stew recipe is sure to be a new family favorite. It is dairy free, gluten free, low carb, keto-friendly, and whole30 compliant. The post Keto Beef Stew (low carb, gluten free) appeared first on Peace Love and Low Carb.

item.title: Keto Taco Soup
item.description: This hearty and delicious Keto Taco Soup Recipe is pure comfort in a bowl. Made with sautéed onions and garlic, browned ground beef and warm spices, this low carb soup is simmered to perfection in a creamy broth made with beef stock, cream cheese, heavy cream, diced tomatoes and green chilies. Finished with garnishes of cheese, avocado, tomatoes, and fresh cilantro. Best of all, it can be ready in less than 30 minutes. The post Keto Taco Soup appeared first on Peace Love and Low Carb.

item.title: Keto Eggnog Cheesecake
item.description: Indulge in a guilt-free, low carb holiday dessert with these delicious Mini Keto Eggnog Cheesecakes. This recipe combines the creamy goodness of cheesecake with the warm, comforting flavors of eggnog and spices. Topped with fresh whipped cream and low carb candied pecans. Perfect for your holiday table and holiday bake sale. The post Keto Eggnog Cheesecake appeared first on Peace Love and Low Carb.

item.title: Keto Chicken Parmesan
item.description: This Keto Chicken Parmesan Recipe is the perfect quick and easy weeknight meal - simple, but loaded with flavor. Tender, juicy chicken breasts, coated in a crispy low carb breading mix, and topped with homemade marinara sauce, mozzarella and parmesan cheeses, then baked to perfection. Best of all, it comes together in less than 30 minutes. The post Keto Chicken Parmesan appeared first on Peace Love and Low Carb.

item.title: Keto Taco Lasagna
item.description: This Keto Taco Lasagna is a delicious way to switch up your taco Tuesday routine. All the delicious flavors of a taco, but in a low carb and gluten free lasagna. Layers of keto noodles, topped with saucy, perfectly seasoned, ground beef, diced tomatoes, green chilies, cheese and olives. Then baked and topped with sour cream, avocado, tomatoes and cilantro. It’s the perfect low carb casserole recipe. The post Keto Taco Lasagna appeared first on Peace Love and Low Carb.
